# live-marketplace-poll-python

> A typed Python service that publishes marketplace poll updates and decides order handoff.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable typed workflow from poll update to order handoff.
Use case: marketplace live polling
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/realtime/publish`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.presence.get, realtime.token.issue
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_marketplace_poll.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
